summary: The same input facade backed by the Input System package, polling devices directly.
overview: Same surface as LegacyInputManager, backed by the Input System package. It polls Keyboard, Mouse and Gamepad directly rather than requiring a pre-authored .inputactions asset, so there is nothing to set up beyond installing the package.
The whole file is inside an ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM guard, so in a project without the package it simply is not compiled rather than breaking the build.
useCases: A project already on the Input System that wants one input facade instead of scattered device reads.
Gamepad and keyboard support without authoring an actions asset first.
Swapping input backends by changing which component is in the scene.

gotchas.title: Polling devices means no rebinding and no action maps
gotchas.body: Direct device reads are what make it zero-setup, and also what rules out the Input System's rebinding, control schemes and action maps. Author an .inputactions asset when you need those.

gotchas.title: Absent entirely without the package
gotchas.body: It compiles only when Unity defines ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM. A scene referencing it in a project without the package loses the component reference.
